summary.text: Lance V. Wheeler is the Republican candidate for West Virginia State Senate District 8 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Kim Hundley; no incumbent is seeking the seat.
He advanced from the May 12, 2026 Republican primary and previously sought the Republican nomination for State Senate in 2014.

paragraphs.text: Lance V. Wheeler graduated from Saint Albans High School and studied economics at the University of Kentucky, according to Ballotpedia.
He resides in his hometown of Saint Albans.
Wheeler ran in the 2014 Republican primary for West Virginia State Senate District 17 and was defeated by Tom Takubo, receiving 31.8 percent of the vote.
